context: A retired exec mentors on long-term planning
purpose: Teach: 損益/総研/送金/搭乗/事後/カ年/みなし/即し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 損益の見方、若い頃は短期に偏っていた。
lines.en: When I was younger, I read P&L statements too narrowly—always chasing the quarterly numbers.
lines.style: Measured opening. Voice settles into reflection. Slow enough to land the confession. Weight on the self-criticism, then let it pass. No regret, just clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。総研の長期予測、最近重視しています。
lines.en: Yes. Lately we've started taking the think tank's long-term forecasts much more seriously.
lines.style: Direct agreement with quiet respect. Lean forward slightly on the word 'seriously'—show you're tracking his point. Even tone, attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 送金規則、各国で違う。海外搭乗の頻度も、事後精査が要る。
lines.en: Remittance regulations shift country to country. And how often we actually travel overseas—that needs careful review afterward, not assumptions.
lines.style: Pragmatic, itemizing without rush. Slight pause between the two points to let each breathe. The voice of someone who learned this the hard way. Concrete.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 5カ年計画、現場の声に即して、みなし規程も入れます。
lines.en: In the five-year plan, we're building in flexibility—rules that bend to what we hear from the teams on the ground.
lines.style: Steady conviction without stiffness. Touch of warmth when naming 'field voices.' You're not reciting procedure—you're describing something you believe in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Quiet, final. Not a command—a principle. Let it land. Slight breath after, the way you'd mark the end of a thought.
